# Psalm 146 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise Yah! Praise O-my-soul YHWH.

**2** I-will-praise YHWH in-my-life; I-will-sing-praises to-my-God while-I-exist.

**3** Do-not trust in-princes, in-son-of man in-whom there-is-no salvation.

**4** Goes-out his-breath, he-returns to-his-earth; in-that day perish his-plans.

**5** Blessed whose-help the-God-of Jacob, whose-hope on-YHWH his-God,

**6** Maker-of heaven and-earth, the-sea and-all that in-them, the-keeper-of truth to-forever,

**7** Doing justice for-the-oppressed, giving food to-the-hungry. YHWH sets-free the-prisoners.

**8** YHWH opens-the-eyes-of the-blind; YHWH raises the-bowed-down; YHWH loves the-righteous.

**9** YHWH keeps the-sojourners; the-fatherless and-the-widow he-sustains, and-way-of the-wicked he-makes-crooked.

**10** Will-reign YHWH to-forever, your-God O-Zion to-generation and-generation. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **146:1**: First of the final Hallel psalms (146-150) — each begins and ends with 'Praise Yah' (Hallelujah).

- **146:7-9**: A catalogue of divine actions: justice, food, freedom, sight, lifting, love, protection — God's character expressed in concrete deeds for the vulnerable.

— EMET
